description: Add the string resource used to localize "Settings & Data".
start_anchor: <string name="info_rewards_body">Set up your own rewards in Settings — treats you\'d be happy to spend gold on, no price tag needed. Every so often, after a handful of completed quests, you\'ll be prompted to redeem one, and it always costs a random 6-12% slice of whatever gold you\'ve banked — so there\'s always something to spend.</string>
